summary: example for sense 1 in Imperativ (Lahdo Traitor 2/17)

data.turoyo: U babo mərle: "Zux marke!" Hawxa, hawxa lo ṭawwo, b naxwaš, hawxa no, mərle: "Zux marke!" Xəd d əmmat yaʕni məqšaṭ, hawxa mede.
data.translation: His father said: go away! In such bad way, brutal, such as, he said: go away! As if he said: get the hell out of here! Or something similar.

rationale: Thin Detransitive Imperativ I.1; speaker explicitly glosses the rough command with məqšaṭ, documenting register rather than a new insult sense.

data.translation: Aber die Frau rief von Neuem: "Fort mit dir!" "So werde ich dich verraten", drohte er.

rationale: Completes Detransitive Imperativ I.1 to five; short command/rejoinder context, with the fox’s reaction.
